build.name: install gcc-multilib: the 1983 code assumes ILP32 (undeclared char *malloc() is implicit int and truncates pointers on x86-64 -> segfault, observed)
build.cmd: apt-get -qq update >/dev/null && apt-get -qq install -y gcc-multilib >/dev/null 2>&1; echo apt-done

build.name: compile as 32-bit K&R (-m32 -std=gnu89 -fcommon -w; no source change)
build.cmd: gcc -m32 -std=gnu89 -fcommon -w -o $BODY/build/compact compact.c tree.c 2>&1 | grep -iE '\berror' | head -5; gcc -m32 -std=gnu89 -fcommon -w -o $BODY/build/uncompact uncompact.c tree.c 2>&1 | grep -iE '\berror' | head -5; test -x $BODY/build/compact && test -x $BODY/build/uncompact && echo built
